techDecisions.decision: Claude IS the iMessage handler — CLAUDE.md instructs Claude to parse tasks and call Supabase directly. No standalone daemon.
techDecisions.rationale: iMessage MCP plugin delivers messages as channel notifications. An active Claude session handles the full loop: parse → insert → reply. Simpler than a separate service.

techDecisions.decision: No SDK, direct fetch to Supabase REST. Short-ID prefix matching via client-side filter.
techDecisions.rationale: PostgREST can't LIKE on UUID columns. With ~100 tasks, client-side filter is fast enough.

techDecisions.decision: Supabase Postgres on shared instance (xwxsrsybllifbivhgojl) with Morning Brew
techDecisions.rationale: Strategy requires shared instance. REST API access via publishable key. No SDK.

techDecisions.decision: Flexible labels table instead of project column
techDecisions.rationale: User requested flexibility — projects, contexts, areas all via label_type. No schema change for new groupings.
